key_idea: Three cases: if you can outbid, bid c+1 (cheapest win); if you can only tie, bid c to keep your cow; otherwise bid 0.
sketch: Compare n with c. n>c: output c+1, the minimal winning bid. n==c: output c, since a tie loses no cow and cows outrank coins. n<c: the cow is lost regardless, so bet 0 to keep all coins. O(1); the only trap is the tie case where betting 0 would gain coins but lose a cow.
